q: What carbon data can a Kutch salt works give a soda ash or chlor alkali buyer?
title: Kutch salt works: carbon data for buyers
short: Diesel or electricity for brine pumps, diesel for harvesting and loading, and freight to the plant, per tonne of salt. Evaporation itself uses sunlight, so the figure is small. Buyers mainly want it measured so their Scope 3 is complete.
audience: Salt producers in Kutch supplying soda ash, chlor alkali and other chemical plants

ol: Pump energy: kWh from bills, or diesel litres.

p: Truck or rail to the chemical plant, by distance and load. Often larger than the salt works itself.
Salt is Scope 3, category 1 for the soda ash or chlor alkali plant.

senseible: Senseible turns supplier invoices into a Scope 3 record with the supplier, quantity and factor behind every figure, so you can see which supplier data is still missing.
